title: Fire and smoke dampers.
officialText:
In cases where the building’s passive fire-resistance protection design, including rated
construction, corridors and fire separations, complies with 1968 or prior codes, the determination as to whether a fire or smoke
damper is required shall be permitted to be made pursuant to the 1968 Building Code, or at the election of the applicant, the
New York City Mechanical Code.
